findings.title: Physical protection is restricted to lexically selected census names and misses alternate filesystem spellings
findings.evidence_kind: source finding; no bespoke or native reproduction executed
findings.reason: Lexical target/subtree checks use case-sensitive Path.is_relative_to. The later native identity loop also considers only raw census names lexically beneath the supplied target. Consequently it never examines the actual existing target or prefix inode when that coordinate is an alternate native spelling of a protected directory.
findings.concrete_condition: On a case-insensitive filesystem, component:LEGACY-PROJECT-WRAPPER with overwrite=True can name the actual protected components/legacy-project-wrapper. Canonical parsing preserves item-name case. Upstream can contain that selected spelling. The destination complete census contains actual lower-case names, so neither lexical subtree comparison nor native candidate selection matches the uppercase target, even though it is the protected wrapper physically.
findings.required_change: Bind every target coordinate prefix to the original complete census/exact actual named node; reject portable alias spellings or existing nodes absent from their exact original names. Compare actual existing target/parent identities against protected nodes independently of lexical filtering. Keep physical and lexical protection rather than substituting a guessed case normalization.
findings.execution_limit: Applicability is conditional on native aliasing behavior; this turn did not execute a case-alias reproduction or verify target-volume case behavior.

findings.title: Linked-worktree owns check can perform reads after final stage known-fact closure
findings.evidence_kind: source call-path finding; no bespoke reproduction executed
call_path: LayoutGitControls.close_native_inputs: originally absent owned linked-worktree locked marker invokes reservations.owns(path)
_StagedReservationSet.owns -> verify_all -> pool.require_current, marker payload reads and private/journal/name traversals
findings.reason: Later closes cover canonical role inputs, control-private censuses and original project/source plan, but do not repeat stages._close_known for actual stage payloads/private stage journal/root. Those can change during the late linked-Git ownership traversal without the final protection currentness observing the changed stage facts.
findings.required_change: Complete this possible traversal before the final global known-facts pass, then close actual stage/private-stage-journal/root facts after it. Alternatively use an actual bound descriptor-only owns view. No payload or namespace traversal should follow the final stage/native close.
findings.execution_limit: This source branch is specific to linked-worktree owned-lock handling. Existing normal-Git maintained positives do not independently exercise that final interleaving.
